extraction.name: MMMU: A Massive Multi-discipline Multimodal Understanding and Reasoning Benchmark for Expert AGI
extraction.description: MMMU is a new benchmark designed to evaluate multimodal models on massive multi-discipline tasks demanding college-level subject knowledge and deliberate reasoning. It includes 11.5K meticulously collected multimodal questions from college exams, quizzes, and textbooks, covering six core disciplines and 30 subjects.
extraction.creator: Xiang Yue, Yuansheng Ni, Kai Zhang, Tianyu Zheng, Ruoqi Liu, Ge Zhang, Samuel Stevens, Dongfu Jiang, Weiming Ren, Yuxuan Sun, Cong Wei, Botao Yu, Ruibin Yuan, Renliang Sun, Ming Yin, Boyuan Zheng, Zhenzhu Yang, Yibo Liu, Wenhao Huang, Huan Sun, Yu Su, Wenhu Chen
extraction.publisher: IN.AI Research, University of Waterloo, The Ohio State University, Independent, Camegie Mellon University, University of Victoria, Princeton University
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The questions in the benchmark were manually collected by a team of 50 college students (including coauthors) from various disciplines and subjects, drawing from online sources, textbooks, and lecture materials. They collected multimodal questions and created new questions based on their expertise where necessary.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Multimodal questions sourced from college exams, quizzes, major textbooks, and online resources spanning six common disciplines.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Data cleaning involved two steps: first, lexical overlap and source URL similarity were employed to identify and eliminate potential duplicate problems. Second, problems were distributed among co-authors for format and typo checking. Finally, problems were categorized into four difficulty levels, and approximately 10% of the problems classified as very easy were excluded.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Annotators were instructed to adhere to copyright and license regulations and avoid data from sites prohibiting copy and redistribution. They annotated all fields, including the question, answer options for multiple-choice questions, the correct answer, image types, question difficulty, and explanation (if there exists).
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: A user-friendly web interface developed for data annotation and verification.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: A secondary review team rigorously vetted annotations for quality and guideline adherence. Regular audits of random samples were conducted. Ambiguities or unclear data instances were flagged for a detailed review process and collaboratively examined in team meetings to establish a standardized approach.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: A team of 50 college students (including coauthors) specializing in various university majors and disciplines.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Annotators were instructed to avoid collecting questions that contain any private information.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The benchmark aims to monitor progress towards Expert AGI, which has societal importance due to the potential for AI systems to reach the substitution threshold for machine intelligence in lieu of human labor, leading to significant risks of job displacement and economic disruption.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The manual curation process may carry biases.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The manual curation process may carry biases, and the focus on college-level subjects might not be sufficient for testing Expert AGI.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Testing and evaluating multimodal models on massive multi-discipline tasks demanding college-level subject knowledge and deliberate reasoning under a zero-shot setting.
